q: What is offers.tier_matrix v3 as used in the retention-offers-roi project?
a: The five-tier retention matrix in force since 2025-09-01: T0 no offer, T1 fee waiver, T2 2.0% cashback boost, T3 2.0pp APR cut and T4 $40 statement credit, set by churn decile and value band.

q: What came of the T3 APR-cut ROI test exp-401 in the retention-offers-roi project?
a: exp-401 measured T3 at 0.82x ROI against 1.41x for T2 cashback; fnd-ror-t3-overspend led to dec-ror-reallocate-t3, and dec-ror-matrix-v4 later removed the APR cut altogether.

q: What does ror-roi-v2 in the retention-offers-roi project depend on?
a: It depends on ror-uplift-v1, the T-learner retention uplift model, and feat-ror-value-band-v2, the credit-loss-adjusted value band, with offer costs taken from the matrix.

q: What is the current retention offer tier matrix in the retention-offers-roi project?
a: Matrix v4, adopted by dec-ror-matrix-v4 for the April 2026 cycle: T2 cashback 1.5%, T3 $25 statement credit and no APR cut; it replaces the interim reallocation in dec-ror-reallocate-t3.

q: What realised ROI does ror-roi-v2 show on the 2026-Q1 wave in the retention-offers-roi project?
a: 1.63x realised ROI, against 1.52x for ror-roi-v1 on the same wave (exp-407).

q: Why was the T3 APR cut removed from the retention-offers-roi offer matrix?
a: Its ROI was 0.82x, the only tier under break-even (fnd-ror-t3-overspend), so dec-ror-reallocate-t3 moved budget to cashback, and matrix v4 then formalised the removal.
